Constructor Detail

FileButtonMapper

public FileButtonMapper(javax.swing.JButton button,
                        javax.swing.JFormattedTextField field)
Binds a "browse" button to a file field.

The button will normally open a dialog for selecting an output file.

Parameters:
button -
field - a formatted text field suitable to display directories.
